every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 maintains a balanced composition with a persistent text card in every frame, whereas Site 2 drops the text card completely during transitions in frames 4 and 7, leaving an empty void on the left.

explains_the_project.reason: While both share the same industrial machine metaphor, Site 1 keeps the explanatory text visible in frames 4 and 7 so the visitor always has context for what the 3D press and caliper are doing.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites feature the exact same grounded 3D scene, industrial materials, lighting, and gridded floor across all frames from 1 to 9.

type_and_layout.reason: Both use the same clean typography and left-aligned card layout, though in Site 1 frame 7 the card stays visible and slightly overlaps the background machine, while Site 2 hides the card entirely in frames 4 and 7, disrupting reading continuity.

overall.reason: Site 1 provides a smoother, uninterrupted reading and visual experience across the entire scroll without the jarring disappearance of explanatory cards seen in frames 4 and 7 of Site 2.
